name: NULLFIGHT CONTINENTAL: Bare-BCI Combat League S6
description: An evolved and partially surfaced successor to the original NULL BOUT underground circuit, NULLFIGHT CONTINENTAL operates in the gray zone between illegal underground fighting and unsanctioned professional sport. Competitors face each other in sealed neural combat chambers — physical bodies restrained in haptic harnesses while BCIs engage in direct adversarial signal combat, with the loser experiencing escalating neural feedback that ranges from disorienting to temporarily incapacitating. No governing body formally claims the circuit; it is run by a rotating consortium of Tier 2 district operators and gray-market BCI technicians.
story_hooks: A BCI technician who maintains equipment for the circuit discovers that one of the operators has been running a skimming program that harvests competitor neural data during matches and selling it to a corporate research division.
A Tier 3 professional who secretly participates in NULLFIGHT for the thrill finds themselves recognized by a colleague — and must decide whether to expose the circuit or be exposed.

A competitor who has never lost begins experiencing fragmented memories that don't belong to her — and realizes the feedback she's been absorbing in matches has been carrying data from her opponents' BCIs.
